sloka: तस्मात्त्वमपि चात्मानं नियम्यैवं समाचर ।तच्छ्रुत्वा सुहृदस्तस्य रामस्य प्रियकारिणः ॥२-३-४६॥
transliteration: tasmāttvamapi cātmānaṁ niyamyaivaṁ samācara ।tacchrutvā suhṛdastasya rāmasya priyakāriṇaḥ ॥2-3-46॥

translations.english: ﻿ Having heard this, Rama's friends quickly reported the matter to Kausalya so that she might be happy.
